done.122:
E06 is the only strategy that ever passed the lab gate. This page
re-examines the three things that most often make backtest results look better than
reality: a universe selected with hindsight, correction for multiple trials,
and stability across periods.
done.136:
Not because of a single p-value, but because of
three mutually supporting pieces of evidence: its edge disappears once the universe is selected without hindsight, all of its profit is concentrated in 2020-2021 and 2023, and the effect vanishes when the data is sampled weekly. DSR itself cannot be used as the deciding factor because its result moves from 0,09 to 0,99 merely by changing the assumption about correlation between trials.
done.214:
E06 selected BTC, ETH, and SOL. All three are still alive and have at some point risen hundreds of times over.
That is a decision that could only be made after knowing the outcome. To test it, the universe
is determined by a rule that does not look into the future: at the start of each month, take the 10 assets
with the highest 30-day median dollar volume, with at least 180 days of history, then go long only those whose
60-day momentum is positive. The candidates include assets that are already dead or permanently collapsed
(LUNA, FTT, SRM, WAVES, ANT, TORN, KLAY, BTS, XEM, REN).

done.1134:
The pattern is clear: Sharpe 3,55 in 2020-2021, negative throughout 2022, back to 1,6-2,4 in 2023,

market regimes; what exists is two bull periods that cover up the rest.

done.1384:
The null test in the previous validation used 81 permutations, so p=0,012 is the resolution
floor (1/81), not the actual value. For finer claims, 1.000 permutations are needed.
